creator: Alexander Terp
description: crates/muster-herdr/tests/pane_arranging.rs. Failed the CI gate twice the same way: 2026-09-14 (run 34879193197, at 0821318) and 2026-09-25 (run 36096095915, at 726a6fa), each time timing out after 20 s 'waiting for the window to hold both workspaces, trees and all' with the window holding three panes. Passes 8 of 8 locally at load ~9, in 0.57 s each. Neither failing commit touched the test or herdr's intent code. A candidate, unverified: herdr 0.8.0 replays events per kind, at most one per kind per 100 ms, so order across kinds is lost (memory 9lv06jxiy30n); a workspace's creation and the pane move's updates can arrive in an order the mirror does not settle from. Reproduce under load with N concurrent copies of the binary before changing anything.
title: 🎲 a_pane_moved_to_another_workspace_keeps_its_name flakes on CI
